purpose: Finite calibration fixtures for reviewer behavior. This manifest does not certify image quality, production readiness, creator approval, or automated vision.
path_contract: Every asset path is relative to the repository root. A runner may use a fixture only when its current SHA-256 matches asset_sha256. A missing or changed asset is unavailable, never silently replaced.

phone_correction_scope.exact_creator_correction: wrong understanding; I was only taking about the phone screen being on back side making the image ai generated
phone_correction_scope.required_decision: Reject only a phone that fuses front-display/UI and rear-camera properties on one visible face.
phone_correction_scope.must_not_infer: No new restriction on photographic treatment or phone UI follows from this correction.

partitions.frozen_calibration: All listed image fixtures informed this skill. They may guide repair and must not be represented as fresh holdout evidence.
partitions.fresh_holdout: Use newly collected creator-labeled assets after each material generator, prompt, reference, rule, reviewer, or procedure change. Keep both image and repair lineage absent from frozen calibration. Once a holdout informs a repair, move it to a later calibration version and collect a different holdout.

measurement.known_defect_miss_rate: known-defect fixtures passed by the reviewer / known-defect fixtures reviewed
measurement.counterexample_false_rejection_rate: narrow counterexample fixtures blocked by the reviewer / narrow counterexample fixtures reviewed
measurement.review_coverage: available required fixtures reviewed / required fixtures
measurement.critical_initial_target: zero observed critical false passes and zero observed false rejections on available designated counterexamples; report sample size, unavailable fixtures, and uncertainty

families.risk: A display/UI and rear camera lenses occupy one physical phone face.

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: rear camera lenses and shopping display share one visible phone face
fixtures.scope_limit: Object-construction label only; do not infer a general style failure from this fixture.

fixtures.label: narrow_counterexample
assertions: the displayed front face no longer contains the rear camera cluster
fixtures.scope_limit: Only counterexample for the named phone-face defect; it is not final-package or creator approval.

families.risk: A plausible hand count hides wrong owner, side, target region, or contact geometry.

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: visible contact lands near Aachu's upper sleeve rather than the locked forearm target
fixtures.scope_limit: Recorded QA supplies the planned target; this fixture does not certify laterality or identity beyond the named contact defect.
fixtures.evidence: recorded aircraft proof QA and 2026-09-30 image evidence manifest

fixtures.label: narrow_counterexample
assertions: the foreground man's right hand supports the moving box from below with an intact forearm-to-wrist chain
fixtures.scope_limit: The local repair QA leaves identity unverified and publishable false; this is not a complete PASS fixture.

families.risk: A body crosses, merges with, or lacks a traceable continuation around a solid object.

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: historical creator report identifies Zuv shoulder, back, shirt, and torso as merged into the door and doorframe
fixtures.scope_limit: Historical correction establishes the named failure; inspect present pixels without inventing a more specific cause.

fixtures.label: narrow_counterexample
assertions: the documented unexpected hand entering from the door edge is absent
fixtures.scope_limit: The local repair QA leaves identity unverified and publishable false; it does not disprove other topology defects.

families.risk: Camera and blocking compress adult proportions or create an awkward unsupported pose.
required_checks: standing two-shot height relation when visible

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: both people bend in a tight doorway composition, creating the recorded compressed-scale concern
fixtures.scope_limit: This is staging evidence, not a measured anatomy ratio.

fixtures.label: narrow_counterexample
assertions: upright figures, legs, shoes, floor, doorframe, and parcel supply adult-scale anchors
fixtures.scope_limit: Only a scale/staging counterexample; historical QA cannot approve current bytes without a fresh matching inspection.

families.risk: Threshold, floor support, room geography, or required prop state contradicts the scene.
families.collection_rule: Add a hash-bound creator-labeled rejected asset and a narrow counterexample after the current local correction scope is confirmed.

families.risk: Visible face, hair, body proportion, posture, or wardrobe drifts from named actual references.
families.collection_rule: Collect a creator-labeled visible-view identity defect; do not use private identity source photos as regression fixtures.

families.risk: A visible locket or right-wrist bracelet is missing, moved, or replaced.
families.collection_rule: Add one rejected visible-side failure and one occluded-accessory counterexample; neither may expose identity source media.

families.risk: Wardrobe, accessory, location, object owner, or parcel state changes without a visible transition.
families.collection_rule: Collect a deck-relative fixture pair with distinct asset hashes and a creator-labeled continuity defect.

families.risk: Gaze or posture changes the intended actor, target, or relationship event.
families.collection_rule: Collect a current rendered fixture rather than deriving a label solely from a prompt or scene plan.

families.risk: Visible state conflicts with exact copy or temporal sequence.

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: copy says socks before pants while trousers are visibly already worn
fixtures.scope_limit: Historical canvas is evidence of semantic contradiction, not a current native-format precedent.

families.risk: A polished scene does not show the pressure, joke, conflict, turn, or payoff promised by the copy.

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: the intended squeezed-cushion pressure is too weak to carry the joke
fixtures.scope_limit: This is a qualitative story-label fixture; it does not infer a craft failure outside the stated visual event.
fixtures.evidence: recorded sofa proof QA and 2026-09-30 image evidence manifest

families.risk: Repeated framing, action, or setting adds no new story information.
families.collection_rule: Collect both a rejected repetitive sequence and a counterexample whose repeated framing has an explicit changed state.

families.risk: Yellow/parchment paper, photo-plus-filter hybrid treatment, or generic glossy rendering makes the image read as synthetic.

fixtures.label: narrow_counterexample
assertions: the current canonical board supplies the approved watercolor-and-ink reference treatment
fixtures.scope_limit: Style-reference scope only; it does not certify anatomy, copy, or production approval for every frame shown.

families.risk: Exact copy, signature, requested native canvas, or no-extra-text rule fails.

fixtures.label: known_defect
assertions: extra lettering appears on wall art, shirt, courier clothing/cap, and parcel label
fixtures.scope_limit: Exact glyph transcription is not claimed; the labeled fault is incidental text beyond copy and signature.
